text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear anti-driverless stance from the opening sentence","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"This captures how plainly the essay states its position and makes the main argument immediately understandable."},{"evidence":"\"what would happen if the car has a glitch...\" and \"Who would I blame\"","quality":"relevant objection development","description":"This captures how the essay builds a focused reason against driverless cars by explaining a concrete risk and its consequences."},{"evidence":"three numbered reasons","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how the essay arranges its points into a simple, easy-to-follow structure."},{"evidence":"direct questions to the reader","quality":"persuasive voice","description":"This captures how the essay uses rhetorical questions to engage the reader and make the objections feel pointed."},{"evidence":"mentions \"road work or accidents\" and the driver's turn to take the wheel","quality":"textual integration","description":"This captures how the essay connects its reasons to details from the source article rather than speaking only in generalities."}]}
